battle.name: 汧城之戰
battle.brief: 貞元二年（786）正月，吐蕃乘唐廷平定朱泚之亂未久、隴右防務空虛，進軍至汧州，汧城守軍據城固守，擋住通向涇州與關中的通道，雙方在渭水上游拉鋸數月。卡面這件羅馬標槍並非戰地出土，而是公元前一世紀的重型投射兵器祖型：中空槍桿配細長鐵頸，刺穿盾面後鐵頸彎折，令敵人難以拔除；它所對照的，正是汧城攻防中真正決定守城的長鉤、礟石與床弩。

kit.name: 羅馬標槍
kit.history: 半米長的投槍，槍幹中空。捅穿盾之後就折斷，敵人只能帶著半截槍退回掩體。

countries: 交戰的兩方是唐王朝與吐蕃。吐蕃一方以青藏高原的蕃部聯盟為核心，在河湟、鄯、廓一帶設節度使與軍鎮，兵制以本部落的騎兵為骨幹，輔以歸義的漢地降戶與編入的外族雇兵，攻城器械由專門的工匠隊伍打造，糧秣多靠劫掠隴右屯田與洮、岷一線的產糧。唐一方在關中與隴右只餘秦州、渭州、涇州、汧州等數處據點，由節度使、刺史與團練使分統；汧州是州城所在，守軍以募兵、團練鄉兵與蕃兵為主，援軍則自長安、鳳翔與京西諸道抽調，糧秣靠渭河漕運與關中轉運支應。兩國在制度上的差距是：吐蕃可以把兵集中在河湟作遠距離機動作戰，唐卻因節度使擁兵自重、朝廷財政空虛，能調動的野戰兵力有限。史載此役具體建制與番將姓名多有缺略，諸說並存，上述是依當時整體邊防體制所作的推想。
countriesEn: The two belligerents were the Tang dynasty and the Tibetan Empire. On the Tibetan side the army was the core of a confederation of Tibetan tribes drawn from the Tibetan plateau, with military districts and garrison towns set up around the Huangshui, Shannan and Guozhou regions; the order of battle rested on the cavalry of the native tribes, supported by surrendered Han Chinese households and by foreign auxiliaries taken into service, while siege engines were built by specialist artisan teams and the grain and fodder were taken largely by raiding the military farms of Longyou and by the produce of the Tao and Min valleys. On the Tang side only a handful of strongpoints remained in Guanzhong and Longyou — Qinzhou, Weizhou, Jingzhou and Qianzhou — under the divided command of jiedushi, prefects and militia commissioners. Qianzhou itself was the seat of its prefecture, and its garrison consisted chiefly of recruited soldiers, locally raised militia and foreign auxiliaries, while the relief troops were drawn from the capital, from Fengtian and from the western circuits of the capital region, and were supplied with grain and fodder carried by the Wei River canal and by convoys out of Guanzhong. The gap between the two states was institutional: the Tibetans could concentrate their troops in the Huangshui valley for long-range mobile operations, whereas the Tang, with jiedushi holding private armies and the treasury empty, could not muster a field army worth the name. The surviving record for this engagement is thin, and the actual formations and the names of the Tibetan commanders are largely missing, with several accounts disagreeing; what is set out above is a reconstruction from the frontier system as a whole.
people: The key figure on the Tang side was the emperor Dezong, Li Shi, who in the early Zhenyuan years had only just seen through the Zhu Ci rebellion and the disaster of Fengtian, and who now faced a frontier army out of control and autonomous regional governors grown strong; his ministers at court, the chancellor Li Mi, argued for holding the line against Tibet rather than opening fresh quarrels, and that leaning broadly decided that Qiancheng would not turn into a counter-offensive. On the defenders of the city itself, the transmitted records preserve only the titles — prefect of the prefecture, militia commissioner, and a number of company officers — and their names are largely lost; all that is certain is that their task was to hold the walls and to keep the road from Qinzhou to the capital open. On the Tibetan side, the Chinese-language sources refer to the ruler only as the shangzhu; what can be established is that during the later eighth century the Tibetan ruler succeeded in curbing the power of the prominent Lu clan and concentrated military and financial authority in the royal house, and that this rearrangement gave Tibet the capacity to mount repeated campaigns into Longyou, and that it was not until 795, when Lun Mang Luobo and others killed the shangzhu and the empire fell into civil war, that the Tang frontier got its breathing space. What records the engagement are the fragmentary annal entries in the Jiu Tangshu, Xin Tangshu and Zizhi Tongjian, the military registers and household registers preserved at Dunhuang, and the entries in administrative compendia such as the Tang Huiyao.

kits: 卡面這件羅馬標槍不是汧城戰場上的出土物，而是公元前一世紀羅馬軍團用來打散敵軍縱列的重型投射兵器：半米左右的中空木桿，前端接一根細長的鐵頸與狹長槍頭，設計重點在於標槍能刺穿盾面而後鐵頸彎折，使中標的敵兵無法拔除，只能拖著半截槍退回掩體；也正因如此，標槍是一次性消耗品。技術譜系上，這條路在羅馬之後被重型弩砲與投石機取代，中世紀歐洲與西亞的攻城戰早已不再依靠人力投擲。放到七八六年的隴右，真正發揮同類功能的是別的東西：唐軍的標槍與長槊、陌刀負責近身反制，擘張弩與床弩提供遠程火力，發石機與砲用於拆毀城頭與城門，滾木礆石、猛火油櫓、鐵蒺藜與鹿角拒馬則用來封住壕溝與攀爬路線；吐蕃的裝備以皮甲、長矛、牛皮盾與弓為主，並攜帶自製的攻城梯、撞木與投石器。真正可與pilum相比的，是標槍「一發即棄」的邏輯與城防器械「打中即棄」的邏輯完全一致：讓進攻者的裝備在命中之後反過來成為負擔。
kitsEn: The Roman pilum on the card is not an excavation from the battlefield at Qiancheng; it is the heavy missile of the first century BCE, used by Roman cohorts to break up enemy columns. It consisted of a hollow wooden shaft of about half a metre, fitted with a slender iron shank and a narrow head, and the whole point of the design lay in the fact that the pilum could pierce a shield and then have its shank bend, so that the man who was hit could not pull it out and had to drag half a weapon back into cover; precisely for that reason the pilum was a consumable thrown once and abandoned. Along the technical lineage, this role passed after Rome to heavy bolt-throwers and stone-throwers, and medieval siege warfare in Europe and West Asia had long since stopped depending on the thrown arm. What filled the same function on the Longyou frontier in 786 was something else entirely: the Tang javelins, long spears and the modao took the counter-attack at close quarters, the bow-arms and bed crossbows supplied the long-range fire, traction trebuchets and stone-throwers were used to break the parapet and the gates, while rolling logs, loose rubble, racks of burning oil, caltrops and antler-shaped cheval-de-frise sealed the ditch and the climbing routes. The Tibetans came equipped in leather armour, with long spears, raw-hide shields and bows, and brought their own scaling ladders, rams and stone-throwers. The one real comparison with the pilum is that the logic of the pilum — thrown once, then abandoned — is exactly the logic of the defensive engine, which also becomes a burden once it has landed: the attacker's own equipment turns into something he must carry away.
tactics: 守方在汧城的打法是典型唐代州城防禦：先以拒馬、鹿角、壕溝與城門前的障礙拖慢對方接近，再以城頭弩手分層射擊，覆蓋壕溝與城門前的進攻通道，關鍵位置架床弩；一旦對方把梯、具推到牆下，就以滾木礆石、長鉤與猛火油櫓傾倒，夜晚則加派巡城與火把照明，防止對方摸黑登城。糧秣防守同樣關鍵：城內必須儲備數月軍食，外部援軍到不了、渭河漕運又被截斷時，城就守不住。進攻方的打法則以吐蕃騎兵的野戰優勢為依托：先以遊騎繞城掠奪糧草、斷援軍通道，把唐軍主力牽制在城內，再集中步卒填壕、撞門、架梯，輔以投石器與火箭拆毀城頭守備，最後集中兵力攻一門。反覆在門外糾纏的目的，是誘使唐軍出城野戰——那正是唐軍最不擅長的場面；而洪流般的騎兵在狹窄的渭水谷地反而難以展開，這也是汧城能守的原因之一。
tacticsEn: The defence of Qiancheng followed the standard Tang pattern for holding a prefectural city. First came the delaying works — cheval-de-frise, antler obstacles, the ditch and obstructions planted in front of the gates — to slow the approach; then the crossbowmen on the parapet fired in layers, covering the ditch and the ground before the gates, with bed crossbows set up at the points that mattered. As soon as the attackers brought ladders and engines up against the wall, the defenders brought down rolling logs, loose rubble, long hooks and racks of burning oil; at night the walls were patrolled with torches kept burning so that no one could climb in the dark. The defence of provisions mattered just as much: the city had to hold several months of military grain, and once the relief army could not come and the grain traffic on the Wei River had been cut, the city could not be held. The attack rested on the tactical strength of Tibetan cavalry in open country. Light horse first rode round the city to carry off grain and fodder and to sever the road of the relieving army, pinning the Tang troops inside; then the infantry were concentrated to fill the ditch, to ram the gates and to set ladders, supported by stone-throwers and fire arrows aimed at the defenders on the wall, and finally the mass was thrown against a single gate. The repeated manoeuvring in front of the gates was meant to lure the Tang army out into the open, which was the one kind of fighting the Tang army was least fitted for; and a torrent of cavalry could not easily deploy in the narrow valley of the Wei, which is one of the reasons Qiancheng held at all.
data: 這一戰的記載本身就稀薄，可以核實的只有框架性的數字與地理。年份是貞元二年，即公元七八六年；起於正月、延續至夏季之說見於部分繫年，月份在不同抄本中不一，本檔案所填的一月即屬此類推斷。地理方面，汧州城在今甘肅定西市隴西縣汧城鎮一帶，處渭水上游、隴山南麓，向東距長安約六百里（按唐里估算），向西北到秦州天水約一百五十里，向東北到涇州約二百六十里，向西到洮州臨洮亦約二百六十里；它正卡在關中通往河西與西域的通道上，因此被稱為隴右的門戶。城池規模依唐代州城通例當在周數里之內，現存城址痕跡亦見方整夯土城垣。兵力方面，漢文史料沒有給出可信數字：吐蕃每次入犯常以數萬騎為主力，守軍則以數千計的團練鄉兵與少量官軍為主，援軍雖有萬眾之眾卻遲滯不至；死傷與俘虜數目史無明文，不可臆造。糧秣上，關中一年之收要供給京畿與數道軍鎮，汧州一城數月的軍食即是沉重負擔，而若渭河漕運一斷，前線撐不過半季。
dataEn: The record of this engagement is itself thin, and only the frame of numbers and geography can be checked. The year is Zhenyuan 2, that is 786 CE; the view that it opened in the first month and ran into the summer appears in some of the annal entries, the month differing between copies, and the January given in this file is a deduction of that kind. Geographically the city of Qian prefecture lay in the region of Qiancheng town in Longxi county, Dingxi prefecture, Gansu, on the upper Wei River at the southern foot of the Long mountains: about six hundred li east to the capital, as measured in Tang li, about a hundred and fifty li north-west to Qinzhou at Tianshui, about two hundred and sixty li north-east to Jingzhou and about the same to the west to Taozhou at Lin Tao. It sat squarely on the road from Guanzhong to Hexi and to the western regions, which is why it was called the gateway of Longyou. Judging by the normal plan of a Tang prefectural city, the circuit of the walls should have run to a few li, and the surviving traces of the site do show a regular rammed-earth rampart. On numbers of troops the Chinese-language sources give no figure that can be trusted: Tibetan raids habitually went in with tens of thousands of horse, while the garrison consisted of a few thousand men of the local militia and regulars with the regulars in the minority, and the relief army, though it mustered ten thousand men, came too late to be of use. There is no record whatever of casualties or prisoners, and none should be invented. As for provisions, a single year's harvest in Guanzhong had to feed the capital region and several circuits; several months of military grain for one city at Qiancheng was already a heavy burden, and if the grain traffic on the Wei River were cut, the front could not have been supplied for half a season.
cause: 打起來的原因有三層。最深的一層是地理與資源：吐蕃自七六三年起攻入關中，並在往後數年間拿下河西走廊北段與鄯、廓二州，等於把唐朝通往西域的商道與鹽鐵收入掐在手中；唐朝要恢復對河湟與河西的支配，就必須在渭水上游與吐蕃爭奪據點，而汧城正是關中通往那片失土的門戶。第二層是唐朝自身的虛弱：七八三年涇原兵變引出朱泚之亂與奉天之難，關中府兵體制崩解，禁軍與邊軍重編，財政因軍費與賑災而空虛，節度使又各擁重兵，中央一時調不出一支能打的野戰部隊。第三層是吐蕃內部的變化：八世紀中期尚主削弱論氏貴族、把兵財集中於王室，使蕃軍得以連續多年在隴右實施機動作戰，而七八六年前後正是其攻勢最盛的階段。直接導火線則是貞元二年春吐蕃在秦州一線得手後，趁唐軍援兵未集、隴右城鎮空虛，兵鋒直指汧州。
causeEn: There are three layers of cause behind the fighting. The deepest is geographical and economic: from 763 the Tibetans had struck into Guanzhong, and over the following years had taken the northern stretch of the Hexi corridor together with Shanzhou and Guozhou, which amounted to cutting off the Tang revenue from the western trade routes and from salt and iron; if the Tang were to recover control of the Huangshui valley and of Hexi, they would have to contest outposts with the Tibetans on the upper Wei, and Qiancheng was the gateway from Guanzhong into that lost territory. The second layer is the weakness of the Tang themselves. The Jingyuan mutiny of 783 had brought the Zhu Ci rebellion and the disaster of Fengtian in its wake; the fubing system of Guanzhong fell apart, the imperial guard and the frontier armies were reorganised, the treasury was emptied by war costs and relief, and the jiedushi each held private armies, so that the centre could not at that moment muster a field army fit to fight. The third layer lies in what was changing inside Tibet: in the middle of the eighth century the shangzhu had cut back the power of the Lu clan and gathered soldiers and money into the royal house, which allowed the Tibetan army to carry out mobile operations in Longyou for several years running, and 786 falls in the height of that offensive. The immediate trigger was that in the spring of Zhenyuan 2, after winning its action on the Qinzhou line, the Tibetans pushed straight at Qianzhou while the Tang relieving army had not yet gathered and the Longyou towns were thin in garrison.
impact: 這一役的直接結果是汧城沒有淪陷，關中與關中通往涼州的通道得以保住，這一點在後來的邊防安排上看得見：次年唐廷設涇原節度使，把渭水東岸到洮水一線的防務固定下來，又在崇信等地增設防備，唐蕃邊界此後二十餘年大致沿渭水與洮水擺動。間接的影響更大：唐蕃拉鋸使絲路東段的交通與互市長期不穩，關中對西域的物資與宗教交流中斷，唐朝轉而以飛錢、鹽法與兩稅等財政手段維持軍費，邊軍募兵化、客兵化與藩鎮割據因此加深，節度使轄地越分越細。軍事技術上，汧城攻防也標誌著唐邊防的重心已由野戰轉向城防投射：床弩、發石機、猛火油與拒馬體系的成熟，說明標槍這類靠人力投擲的單次兵器，在面對夯土城垣與壕溝時早已退居輔助位置；同時它也提醒人注意唐蕃邊界的供給現實——渭河一線的水運與關中的糧，不是任何一場會戰可以取代的。
impactEn: The immediate result of the engagement was that Qiancheng did not fall, and the road from Guanzhong to Liangzhou was preserved — a point that is visible in the frontier arrangements that followed. The next year the Tang court set up the Jingyuan jiedushi, fixing the defence along the line from the east bank of the Wei to the Tao, and added garrison preparations at places such as Chongxin; for more than twenty years afterwards the Tang-Tibetan border shifted along the Wei and the Tao. The indirect effects were larger still. The seesaw warfare made traffic and mutual trade on the eastern stretch of the Silk Road chronically unstable, cut off the flow of goods and of religious intercourse between Guanzhong and the western regions, and drove the Tang court to maintain its military spending through financial measures such as paper money, the salt monopoly and the two-tax system; the recruitment, the reliance on foreign soldiers and the autonomy of the regional commands all deepened, and the territories of the jiedushi were subdivided further and further. In military technology the fighting at Qiancheng marks the shift of the Tang frontier away from field battle and towards the projection of siege defence: the maturing of bed crossbows, traction trebuchets, burning oil and cheval-de-frise shows that a single-shot missile thrown by human arm, of the pilum's kind, had long since been relegated to a secondary role against a rammed-earth wall and a ditch. It also underlines the supply reality of the Tang-Tibetan border: the water traffic of the Wei and the grain of Guanzhong could not be replaced by any single pitched battle.
result: 打到最後，雙方都沒有取得決定性突破。汧城守軍頂住了吐蕃的攻勢，吐蕃未能把城拿下；唐軍也沒有能力反推出去，奪回秦州與渭水西岸；圍城與反圍城的消耗戰拖了數月，吐蕃的遠征騎兵因補給與士氣消耗而退回洮、岷方向，唐軍則因久戰與糧秣吃緊而收縮防線。戰線最後回到渭水上游，雙方在秦州、渭州、涇州、汧州一線反覆拉鋸。此役之後，唐廷把涇原、崇信等地的軍鎮重新編排，加固烽燧與城防，吐蕃則在尚主集權之下繼續保持攻勢，直到七九五年論莽羅波刺殺尚主、蕃內大亂，形勢才慢慢轉為對唐方有利；及至八〇六年的清水之約劃定疆界，收復河湟才真正開始。若以成敗論，汧城之戰是一次守住要地的邊境消耗戰：雙方都沒有輸掉這場戰爭，也都沒有贏得這場戰爭。
resultEn: In the end neither side gained a decisive breakthrough. The garrison of Qiancheng withstood the Tibetan assault and the city was not taken; nor could the Tang push back out and recover Qinzhou and the west bank of the Wei. The war of siege and counter-siege dragged on for months, the Tibetan expeditionary horse withdrew towards the Tao and Min valleys as their supplies and their morale wore down, and the Tang, exhausted by long service and squeezed by grain shortage, contracted their defences. The front settled back on the upper Wei, and the two sides pulled at each other repeatedly along the line of Qinzhou, Weizhou, Jingzhou and Qianzhou. After the engagement the Tang court reorganised the commands at Jingzhou, Chongxin and the neighbouring posts, strengthening beacon towers and city defences, while Tibet pressed its offensive on under the centralised authority of the shangzhu, until in 795, when Lun Mang Luobo killed the shangzhu and the empire broke into civil war, the situation slowly began to turn in the Tang's favour; only with the 806 treaty at Qingshui, which drew the boundary, did the recovery of the Huangshui valley genuinely begin. Judged as a result, the battle of Qiancheng was a frontier war of attrition in which a vital post was held: neither side lost the war, and neither side won it.
